text: Can we get a dark mode in the editor? I write PRDs at night and the white background hurts.
Not a priority this quarter, but I will add it to the list.
Honest question: which doc is current, the PRD or the brief? I opened both and they disagree on the launch date.
The brief is stale. We agreed in the thread last week to slip the launch by two weeks and nobody updated either doc.
As an engineer I read the brief first. I only open the PRD when I need an edge case.
Reminder that every PRD needs a success metric before it goes to review. Half of the drafts I see this month still have none.
I do not trust a suggested metric unless I can see why it was picked. Show me the reasoning and I will use it.
